title: ConnectionHelperRefreshResult
description: Acknowledges that the far helper's owner accepted a refresh press. The redial and its hello continue on pane.connection as the axis changes; this RPC does not wait for them and never installs. `refreshed` is true because a refusal is an error, never a result with a false flag.

connectionId.description: The connection whose helper is being redialled. It is the id the pane's observation carried, shared by every pane riding the connection.

refreshed.description: The request was accepted. It says nothing about the redial's outcome; the axis reports serving, helper-lost or another reason as it happens.
